geometry_edits.rationale: Turn the dominant mass into a courtyard-bearing macro so the frontage can be materially opened rather than merely scaled.
Match the open side to the program-frame access side indicated by the design concept graph.
Carve a usable public void large enough to read in all views while preserving one clear dominant body.

graph_edits.rationale: Replace the lifted-bar behavior with an explicit carve so the public threshold can respond to the verified access edge.
Align the void opening to the program frame access side and create a legible public entry/court condition.
Keep the carve bounded and usable, not decorative, while preserving the dominant bar gesture.

rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent bar-like mass in all four views, so the basic gesture and hierarchy are understandable. It also contains a modest roof modulation that prevents a totally flat generic box, and the parcel is respected without obvious view-to-view collisions. However, the required neighborhood-living ground relation is only weakly expressed: the blue frontage edge is answered by a mostly sealed side, with no convincing public void, court, notch, or undercut to activate the access edge. As a result, the form is acceptable as an early massing but still underdeveloped in public-threshold logic and section depth. It is not a wrong typology, but it currently behaves more like a lifted/stacked office-like bar than a socially legible neighborhood building.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Much taller and more tower-like than the candidate; candidate should not copy the skyline object, only the idea of a resolved upper silhouette.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Stepped/tapered upper mass can stay coherent when paired with a clear primary volume and a legible ground relation.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Office tower typology is only loosely relevant to neighborhood living; avoid over-verticalizing the mass.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A single dominant mass with a subtle vertical modulation can preserve hierarchy without fragmenting the whole.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Restaurant/cafe scale is much smaller and more pavilion-like than the candidate; use only the threshold lesson, not the proportion.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A simple low bar plus a small vertical emphasis can clarify ground contact and public threshold.

warnings: Public access edge response is weak: the frontage reads more sealed than active.
The void/court concept from the graph is not visually legible yet.
Section is calm but thin; a more explicit ground carve would better support the program contract.
